archetype: Archetype 6 (Vibrant Play) blended with Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy)

color_palette.rules: Avoid pure black (#000000). Use #1A1A1A for text. Background is a warm off-white (#FDFCF0) to feel organic, appetizing, and bright.

scale.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none text-text_primary
scale.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-text_primary

spacing_and_layout.marketing_grid: Bento 'Tetris' style with gap-8 to gap-12. Asymmetric layouts to feel dynamic and modern.
spacing_and_layout.admin_grid: Dense 'Control Room' grid with gap-4 to gap-6.
spacing_and_layout.generous_spacing: Sections should use py-24 or py-32 for luxurious breathing room.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-[2rem] or rounded-3xl for marketing cards to feel fun and bouncy. rounded-lg for Admin panel.

header.state_top: Transparent background, links in dark text or white depending on the hero image behind it.
header.state_scrolled: Crystal Glassmorphism: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/80 border-b border-white/40 shadow-sm.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) bg-[#FF6B00] text-white hover:bg-[#E65C00] hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 font-bold px-8 py-4.
buttons.secondary: Pill-shaped bg-[#FFD600] text-[#1A1A1A] hover:bg-[#E6C200] transition-all font-bold px-8 py-4.

product_cards.style: Neumorphism mix: soft ambient shadow, flat solid surface. Generous p-8 padding. Use vibrant background tints for different flavors (e.g., bg-yellow-50, bg-orange-50).
product_cards.twist: Product images MUST 'break out' of the card container using absolute positioning or negative top margin for a dynamic 3D popping effect.

admin_panel.style: Functional, clean. Use Shadcn primitives (Tables, Forms, Dialogs). Keep styling minimal, prioritize data density and usability.

motion_and_interactions.hero: Floating chips using GSAP or framer-motion. Animate y-axis (yoyo) and slight rotation to simulate anti-gravity and playfulness.
motion_and_interactions.scroll: Parallax scrolling on background blobs/waves. Staggered fade-up (`y: 40, opacity: 0` to `y: 0, opacity: 1`) for bento grid elements as they enter viewport.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Hover states on all cards (lift up + larger shadow). Ingredient images scale slightly on hover.

home.hero: Immersive banner with floating chips around a giant Montserrat H1. CTA to 'Explore Flavors'. Wave background divider at the bottom.
home.product_highlights: Horizontal swiper or grid of breaking-out product cards.
home.why_us: Bento grid combining text blocks and lifestyle images.
home.ingredients: Marquee or stagger layout of fresh ingredients with health benefits.
home.where_to_buy: Preview of online marketplaces with recognizable logos.
home.testimonials: Swiper carousel with soft pastel/organic background.

pages_structure.about_us: Story-driven, editorial layout. Large typography, asymmetrical image placements representing the mission and manufacturing quality.
pages_structure.products: Colorful grid of rounded cards. High contrast. Filters at the top.
pages_structure.product_details: Split layout: Sticky massive product image on the left, scrollable nutritional details, ingredients, and health benefits on the right.
pages_structure.store_locator: Split layout: Map on one side, search (city/state/pincode) and list on the other. Use custom styled markers.
pages_structure.available_online: Grid of Marketplace cards (Amazon, Flipkart, Blinkit, Zepto) with hover lifting effects.
pages_structure.admin_panel: Sidebar navigation. CRUD tables for Products, Stores, Testimonials, Marketplaces, Vending.

image_urls.description: Close up potato chips, use for hero floating elements.
Rustic chips display for product detail page and about page.
People enjoying snacks together for About Us or Testimonials.
Fresh herbs and spices for the Healthy Ingredients section.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute for testing.
Do NOT use Inter for headings. Use Montserrat Black/ExtraBold for maximum impact.
Apply 'Mobile First' principles: stack grids to 1 column on mobile.

Tech Translation: The user requested GSAP and SwiperJS. Since the stack is React, you may use `@gsap/react` or `framer-motion` to recreate the fluid, floating scroll trigger effects. For sliders, `swiper/react` or Shadcn Carousel (Embla) are perfectly suited.
Make product images 'pop' out of their cards using negative margins or absolute positioning to give a 3D feel.
For the admin panel, rely on Shadcn components for tables and forms. Keep the admin panel strictly functional.
